record.paper_title: Slices of Brownian Sheet: New Results, and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Hausdorff dimension of slice double points
record.original_question: For a d-dimensional two-parameter Brownian sheet B and for each s ≥ 0, define Y_d(s) = {(t_1,t_2) ∈ R_+^2 : B(s,t_1) = B(s,t_2)}; this is the set of double points of the slice t ↦ B(s,t). If d ∈ {4,5}, is it true that outside one null event that works simultaneously for all s ≥ 0, the Hausdorff dimension of Y_d(s) is 0 for every s ≥ 0?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 2. Deﬁne, for all s ≥ 0, Yd(s) := {(t1,t 2) ∈ R2 + : B(s,t 1) = B(s,t 2)}. (8.2) Then is it the case that if d ∈ { 4, 5} then, outside a single null-set, dimH Yd(s) = 0 for all s ≥ 0?
Next, we consider the random set, Dd := {s ≥ 0 : B(s,t 1) = B(s,t 2) for some t2>t 1> 0}. (1.9) We can note that s ∈ Dd if and only if the slice of B along s has a double point.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B=\{B(s,t)\}_{(s,t)\in\mathbb{R}_+^2}$ be a $d$-dimensional two-parameter Brownian sheet; that is, $B$ is a centered Gaussian random field taking values in $\mathbb{R}^d$ whose $d$ coordinate processes are i.i.d. centered Gaussian fields with covariance $\mathbb{E}[B^{(i)}(s,t)B^{(i)}(s',t')] = \min(s,s')\min(t,t')$. For each $s\ge 0$, define the random set of slice double points
$$Y_d(s) := \{(t_1,t_2)\in\mathbb{R}_+^2 : B(s,t_1)=B(s,t_2)\}.$$
Let $\dim_H$ denote Hausdorff dimension. For $d\in\{4,5\}$, decide whether there exists a single $\mathbb{P}$-null event $\mathcal{N}$ such that, off $\mathcal{N}$,
$$\dim_H Y_d(s) = 0 \quad \text{for every } s\ge 0.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the literature on slices of the Brownian sheet. Related results have been established (e.g., that the critical Brownian sheet does not have double points, and that the set of times $s$ for which the slice has a double point is non-trivial iff $d\le 5$), but no source was found in which the simultaneous-in-$s$ statement about $\dim_H Y_d(s)=0$ for $d\in\{4,5\}$ is proved or refuted.

status_evidence.title: Slices of Brownian Sheet: New Results, and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open Problem 2 asks whether for d in {4,5}, outside a single null set, dim_H Y_d(s)=0 for all s.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Critical Brownian sheet does not have double points
status_evidence.snippet: In critical dimensions the Brownian sheet has no double points.
status_evidence.claim: Related (but distinct) critical-dimension result on double points of the whole sheet.

status_evidence.title: Multiple points of the Brownian sheet in critical dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: k-multiple points in critical dimensions (k-1)d=2kN do not exist almost surely.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on multiple points in critical dimensions, not the slice problem.
